pages.text: The red god of the desert and of storms, 500 health, in a temple in the Valley of the Kings. His sandstorm wounds, blinds and throws back; he steps behind his foe and calls jackals.
Set tore out the eye of Horus, and Horus healed it and beat him: without the eye Set takes only a quarter of the harm, and with it his storm cannot blind. Drops the was-sceptre.
